correctness.rationale: PASS: Verified the local divisor-sum difference equals 1+p^a-q*Delta_a(p), so integrality converts strict inequality to q*Delta<=p^a. For fixed a, Delta=p^d(1+O_a(p^-1)), leading cutoff p^b and prime split T=X^(1/(a+b)). PNT and partial summation give the small-p contribution T^(b+1)/(b(b+1)log^2 T) and large-p T^(b+1)/(b(a-1)log^2 T); the p>T^(1+epsilon) tail is lower order, and diagonal p=q is negligible. Converting log T gives K_a and no a-uniformity. Independent enumeration of p,q up to X=100000 verified exact criterion with counts for a=2,3,4,5 equal 233,87,28,52. These finite counts are not a proof of the limit.
